reviews.text: Have just used Scooby's for the second time for my older, anxious dog. Everyone who works in this groomers is fantastic! I was worried about using a new place for her, but I'm honestly blown away by how lovely and caring they are here. I wish I'd found them long before now.

Really happy with the grooming and teeth-cleaning service! My dog looks and smells amazing, and was so well cared for throughout. The groomer was friendly, professional, and clearly great with dogs. The teeth cleaning was an added bonus, and I’m really pleased with the results. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back! 🐾 …

Miley has experienced the starter puppy package.I just can’t believe how excited she is to get through the front door.Picking Miley up after being cut was emotional as she looked so gorgeous.
All the girls are lovely and professional I would highly recommend Scooby’s

Some massive love to Scoobys.
After one poor service in London.We were trying to find a good or well advised groomer close in our current vicinity.

So we were amazed and so happy with today's cut.
You could tell there was so much care involved and love given.I won't go anywhere else in future.
Couldn't recommend any more than this place.
Xx

Siomha has just completed the first four parts of  Scooby’s puppy package - a comprehensive introduction to the grooming experience for your puppy.
She loves the place, after her first visit she is practically dragging me in the door when we get close. The staff, especially Lil, are very enthusiastic as well as attentive and provide great feedback on how each session has progressed. On our 4th visit, Siomha had a mini pamper sesh which included a face massage, during this Lil spotted a little lump on Siomha’s upper cheek and a visit to the vets this morning revealed that to be a a small abscess in her mouth - I would never have spotted this alone as it’s in an area that doesn’t receive much touch or fuss from me so huge thanks to Lil for bringing that to my attention.
I can’t wait for Siomha’s fur to grow enough to get her back for the full grooming experience but she’ll be more than happy to drag me back in for another mini pamper in a few weeks.
Beautiful people and the perfect place to take your beloved pooch for a pamper. Thank you Scooby’s 💚

I booked my Maltipoo puppy in for a puppy package, which he has just completed and had his first full cut. From the very first visit, my puppy got a lovely warm welcome from all staff members and was happy to return every week. His first cut went amazingly, he looks so smart and handsome, and most importantly, was exactly what I asked for.
Thank you Scooby’s!

I can’t praise this salon enough. I have a nervous small dog with allergies. Lil cares for Bailey  like she is her own dog which makes the grooming process less stressful for her and she will keep me informed on any skin problems which I might not know about. I really enjoy the promotions run throughout the year too as my dog gets a pamper and I get some lovely photographs. Thank you Jade and the team.

Booked my Cavapoo into this dog groomer looks good and professional. Got asked to pay deposit but I don’t get paid until the day so I asked if I could just pay cash and I got a text to say they had cancelled the appointment the day before!! Called the woman but very dismissive and not understanding atall of my situation, luckily found another one

We took our very anxious Dachshund to Scoobys for his teeth to be cleaned. In 1 session they have done amazing. He was calm when he came home (unlike him he is usually stressed for a few hours) and you could tell from being in the salon how kind they had been with him.

Excellent service. Took my nervous Sheltie for a teeth clean yesterday and the staff couldn’t have been kinder. The results are amazing (see the before and after photo). Neville came out a very happy dog! Thanks to all the staff
Compassionate and caring groomers, all thr staff are so lovely,  my Summer lives her pampers there, she always comes out looking so beautiful! Xx
